business_summary: People, Dreams & Technologies Group Co., Ltd. engages in consultancy, service provider, and products businesses in Japan. The company provides survey, plan, design, and construction management related to bridges and special structures, roads, ITS, ports and river disaster prevention, environment, and railways; various structural analyses and experiments; commercial construction work; design related to civil engineering structures and facilities; transportation, road development, route, and urban and regional plans; and general information services, such as data management for various public facilities. It is also involved in the provision of consulting, systemization planning, design, and software development related to information processing; content development; operation and distribution services; business surveys and advisory related to PFI; consulting, planning and design related to architecture; soil and geological surveys; research and development on foundation structures and construction methods; design and construction of disaster prevention works and civil engineering works related to ground disasters; construction supervision, EPC management, fundraising consulting, O and M consulting, and asset management related to renewable energy. In addition, the company operates road and public facility; PPP; demand-responsive transportation system; health support and rental activities; and renewable energy and finance businesses. Further, it sells eco products and information system. People, Dreams & Technologies Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
